description: This file is a header file defining interfaces for a trigger/emulator system related to position sensors, including initialization and configuration functions.

methods.name: initTriggerEmulator
methods.description: Initializes the trigger emulator with shared logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: setTriggerEmulatorRPM

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeRpmEmulatorCallback
methods.description: Handles configuration change callbacks for RPM emulator adjustments.
